# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter

observations.why: The 'we' enacts communal-sharing as a unified team body; the velocity-points framing enacts market-pricing proportionality, measuring output in quantified units against a quarterly benchmark.
Superlative framing and 'key unlock' phrasing carry energized enthusiasm over the team's achievement — high arousal, positive valence.

evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: All three clauses report completed, actual events with named artifacts — attention is on what happened, settled and concrete.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock

observations.why: Velocity framed as a quarterly high performs achievement-standing; naming the integration as the 'key unlock' performs mastery-capability of craft.

The Zephyr integration is spoken of AS a lock-mechanism ('unlock'), a metaphor mapping the integration onto a physical key that releases a constraint — not mere vividness but a thing-as-another-thing figure.

payload.focus: Sprint retro: async decision widget shipped, velocity 23 points highest this quarter, Zephyr integration as key unlock
payload.rationale: This sprint retro directly echoes the prior Sprint 4 retro (Sample_Sprint4Retro_20260322) — same shipped feature (async decision widget), same velocity metric (23 points), same Zephyr integration as key unlock. I expanded the two core narratives (AntiSlackPositioning, DecisionCaptureAtConsensus) and their child positions (ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, AntiPatternRealtimeChat) because the retro's claims about shipping the widget and proving the thesis bear directly on those framing positions. I included Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Obs_TinaVelocity, Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved, and Position_Sprint4ThesisProven as the load-bearing prior witnesses this retro extends or corroborates. StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor is included because this document repeats the same numeric-anchored claim style ('23 points, highest this quarter'). Position_PricingTwelveDollars is included because the sprint retro context records a pricing update. I did not expand Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams or Position_PricingTwelveDollars's siblings since the document makes no ICP or packaging claims.
